workarounds.note: the lesson and fable numbers are typed into the headings: a numberingTemplate joins the number to the title's first span (buildBlockKind.ts, the heading case), and when that span is a ruby base the reading is centred over the number and the first character together; the `marked` test there should count ruby, warichu, emphasis marks, name and title lines, tcy and orientation runs

each box and picture of the upper tier is fenced or cited where the channel of its page has room: a span 'side' box, or a side figure queued behind one, that finds no room before the text ends gets a page of its own with nothing under it, and the ones after it are dropped with no warning (in both writing modes; figures alone get pages of their own)
